title: Files
description: Decentralized file archive — share media over Blossom HTTP and BitTorrent.
summary: The device's content-addressed media archive: every file referenced by an APRX file: token lives here, deduplicated by its SHA-256. Add files to get shareable tokens, search for hashes announced by others, and make your archive available to the network through a Blossom-compatible HTTP endpoint and a BitTorrent seeder — anyone who downloads a file can become a provider of it.
